races.race_name: Follow Us On Instagram @ GuidenstownStud Irish EBF Maiden

runners.name: Tradewinds
runners.spotlight: Useful form but not notably progressive since a C&D third placing behind the subsequent Railway Stakes winner Celeron over C&D on his second outing; however, officially assessed as improving by 5lb when third on his nursery debut.
runners.comment: Consistent, not notably progressive but was raised 5lb for a nursery run three weeks ago

runners.name: Snowing
runners.spotlight: No Nay Never filly was sent off at 7-1 on debut over C&D, weakened into fifth behind her high-class stablemate Sun Goddess who runs in the featured Phoenix Stakes; no match for a stablemate of New Bond Street when dropped to 5f at Naas; should not be far away.
runners.comment: No match for a stablemate of New Bond Street at Naas, should be in the mix now
runners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.name: Jewel In A Crowd
runners.spotlight: Improved from a first outing at Cork when third of 12 over C&D in June; Aidan O'Brien supplied the winner, second and fourth, the form looks rock-solid; winner Abraham Lincoln and runner-up Haffner have both taken the runner-up in Group 2 events in Britain, and fourth-placed Man's Best Friend won the Richmond Stakes.
runners.comment: Form of C&D third well-advertised in British Pattern races by a Ballydoyle-trained trio,
runners.owner: Exors of the Late Mrs Dolores Gleeson

runners.name: New Bond Street
runners.spotlight: 65,000gns yearling, 200,000gns Breeze Up purchase; slowly away and ran green when odds-on for a Cork maiden won by the smart Ballinea Star; can be rated a likely future winner on her third behind the subsequent Richmond Stakes winner Man's Best Friend at Naas.
runners.comment: Third behind the subsequent Richmond Stakes winner Man's Best Friend at Naas, good chance

runners.name: Atlantic Bridge
runners.spotlight: Bought for E300,000 at a Breeze-Up in May; ninth foal; half-brother to four winners; made a satisfactory debut over 5f here three weeks ago; this race looks deeper.
runners.comment: Made a satisfactory debut over 5f here three weeks ago, this race looks deeper

runners.name: New World Order
runners.spotlight: E180,000 Breeze Up buy; first foal; Starspangledbanner colt; dam unraced half-sister to two winners, out of 7f/1m Listed winning half-sister to 5f Group 1 winner Equiano; Oisin Murphy booked
runners.comment: E180,000 Breeze Up buy, Starspangledbanner colt, family of Equiano, Oisin Murphy booked

runners.name: My Lucky Journey
runners.spotlight: Showed inexperience first time out at Naas; fourth behind subsequent Richmond Stakes winner Man's Best Friend was promising in the circumstances; likely to improve.
runners.comment: Promising fourth behind subsequent Richmond Stakes winner Man's Best Friend at Naas

runners.name: Brageiro
runners.spotlight: E120,000 Y; second foal; half-sister to 7f 2yo winner Down The Glen (RPR 73); dam 1m AW winner (70), half-sister to winners Flaming Spear (1m Listed), Taqseem (UAE 5f Listed) and Desert Blossom (useful 7f 2yo), out of Group-placed 7f 2yo winner
runners.comment: E120,000 yearling; half-sister to trainer's 7f 2yo winner Down The Glen, dam 1m AW winner

runners.name: Katty
runners.spotlight: E155,000 Y, E72,000 2yo; eighth foal; half-sister by Ghaiyyath to three winners; dam German Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner; stable not often associated with juveniles.
runners.comment: Half-sister by Ghaiyyath to three winners, stable not often associated with juveniles

runners.name: Marco Polo
runners.spotlight: 525,000gns yearling; fourth foal; brother by Night Of Thunder to 6f 2yo/7f Listed winner Saber Strike (RPR 109), half-brother to a 6f/7f winner; dam 5f 2yo winner, sister to 6f Listed winner Swiss Dream; interesting prospect but Ryan Moore prefers the twice raced Snowing.
runners.comment: 525,000gns yearling, interesting prospect but Ryan Moore prefers the twice-raced Snowing

runners.name: Bengal Tiger
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; No Nay Never colt is closely related to two winners; half-brother to Listed winner Galleria Borghese; dam unraced sister to 1m 2yo Group 1 winner Kingsbarns; apparent third-string for Ballydoyle
runners.comment: Half-brother to Listed winner Galleria Borghese, apparent third-string for Ballydoyle

runners.name: Nando The Great
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; half-brother by Nando Pararado to winners Asadna (Listed-placed), Watermelon Sugar (multiple 6f scorer) and Good Listener (5f 2yo); not one of the more obvious contenders in a strong maiden.
runners.comment: Half-brother by Nando Parrado to three winners, not one of the more obvious contenders

runners.name: Joltin Joe
runners.spotlight: E38,000 2yo; fifth foal; half-brother by Persian Force to two winners; dam placed 5f, out of unraced close relative of 1m Group 3 winner Hathal; faces a stiff task in a maiden of this standard.
runners.comment: Half-brother by Persian Force to two winners, stiff task in a maiden of this standard

runners.name: A I Nation
runners.spotlight: E130,000 F, E42,000 2yo; third foal; by Sioux Nation, dam 5f-1m winner, sister to 5f 2yo Group 2 winner Prince Of Lir; trainer also runs New World Order with Oisin Murphy up.
runners.comment: By Sioux Nation, dam 5f-1m winner, trainer also runs New World Order with Oisin Murphy up

runners.name: King Paddy
runners.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-brother to two minor AW winners; dam unraced half-sister to two juvenile winners; from the family of Derby second and leading jumps sire Walk In The Park
runners.comment: Half-brother to two minor AW winners, family of leading jumps sire Walk In The Park

runners.name: Push The Boat Out
runners.spotlight: 37,000gns Y, 85,000gns Breeze Up; Kodi Bear colt, second foal; dam unplaced, closely related to 6f Listed winner An Saighdiur; Colin Keane takes the ride
runners.comment: Unplaced dam is closely related to 6f Listed winner An Saighdiur; Colin Keane aboard

runners.name: Mutamarid Lsk
runners.spotlight: Down the field in maidens at Fairyhouse and Naas; safe to rule out.
runners.comment: Down the field in maidens at Fairyhouse and Naas, safe to rule out

runners.name: Luca Brillante
runners.spotlight: Finished with only one behind her when sent off at 33-1 on debut at Naas in May.
runners.comment: Finished with only one behind her when sent off at 33-1 on debut at Naas in May

runners.name: Santerno
runners.spotlight: Made little impact in the early-season C&D maiden won by the Coventry Stakes winner Great Barrier Reef; should be more street-wise now.
runners.comment: Should be more street-wise than on his debut fifth behind the talented Great Barrier Reef

races.race_name: Grand Hotel Malahide Irish EBF Fillies Juvenile Race

runners.name: Ibelieveicanfly
runners.spotlight: Chased home Alpha over C&D on second start; form has been given a strong endorsement by Livenka; failed to settle when a short-priced favourite here three weeks ago; if she is more cooperative in a first-time hood, she should reverse form with  Admired Beauty.
runners.comment: Needs to settle better if he is to reverse C&D form with Admired Beauty
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Flaxman S

runners.name: Miss Hong Kong
runners.spotlight: E165,000 yearling; fourth foal; daughter of Churchill is a sister to two winners, half-sister to a US 6.5f turf winner; dam 7f 2yo winner (92); one of two newcomers here for her trainer.
runners.comment: Churchill filly, sister to two winners, half-sister to a US turf winner; dam 7f 2yo winner

runners.name: Popped
runners.spotlight: Wootton Bassett filly is a sister to a 7f 2yo/1m winner; unraced dam is sister to winners Tapestry (7f 2yo Group 2/1m4f Group 1) and John F Kennedy (1m 2yo Group 3), out of Moyglare Stud Stakes/Prix Marcel Boussac winner Rumplestiltskin; trainer also runs Miss Hong Kong.
runners.comment: Wootton Bassett filly, unraced dam has a top-notch pedigree, one of two for the trainer
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Flaxman S

runners.name: Admired Beauty
runners.spotlight: Finished in front of odds-on failure Ibelieveicanfly here three weeks ago, can feature but not certain to uphold the form if that opponent reproduces her previous form.
runners.comment: Finished in front of odds-on failure Ibelieveicanfly here three weeks ago, can feature

runners.name: Exceptionally
runners.spotlight: Leopardstown third marked a big improvement from his first start; more progress required; Ryan Moore on Ibelieveicanfly.
runners.comment: Leopardstown third marked a big improvement from his first start, more progress required
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Rathbran Lady
runners.spotlight: E1,000 yearling; by Arizona, first foal out of a 7f 2yo winner by Profitable; big task.
runners.comment: Cheap yearling, by Arizona, first foal out of a 7f 2yo winner by Profitable. big task

runners.name: Torvella
runners.spotlight: E140,000 Y; fourth foal; half-sister by Torquato Tasso to three winners; dam US turf winner, half-sister to 1m2f Group 3 winner Crossfirehurricane and 1m Listed winner My Generation
runners.comment: E140,000 yearling, fourth foal, half-sister to three winners; dam US turf winner,

runners.name: Chattering Classes
runners.spotlight: 52,000gns yearling; second foal; half-sister by Ghaiyyath to 6f 2yo winner Slay Queen; dam French Group-placed 7f 2yo winner; in good hands.
runners.comment: Half-sister by Ghaiyyath to a 2yo 6f winner, dam Group-placed 2yo winner; in good hands

runners.name: Darlene
runners.spotlight: Third foal; by King Of Change out of a 6f winner by Kyllachy; 7lb claimer aboard,; probably best watched.
runners.comment: by King Of Change out of a 6f winner by Kyllachy; 7lb claimer up, probably best watched.

runners.name: Suomenlinna
runners.spotlight: E350,000 yearling; sixth foal; half-sister by Too Darn Hot to three winners, including the Group-placed Villanova Queen; dam unraced half-sister to 1m Group 1 (Sussex Stakes) winner Here Comes When.
runners.comment: E350,000 yearling, half-sister by Too Darn Hot to three winners, well-related unraced dam

runners.name: Voice Of You
runners.spotlight: Made a satisfactory debut at Leopardstown; faces a tough task here but of some long-term interest.
runners.comment: Made a satisfactory debut at Leopardstown, tough task here but of some long-term interest

runners.name: Katiraya
runners.spotlight: Slowly away and ran green first time out at Leopardstown; will need more experience.
runners.comment: Slowly away and ran green first time out at Leopardstown, will need more experience
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Speckles
runners.spotlight: Finished behind three of these rivals when introduced here three weeks ago; open to improvement but will get better opportunities than this.
runners.comment: Finished behind three of these rivals when introduced here three weeks ago
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: Green Sparkle
runners.spotlight: Last of nine first time out in a race contested by four of these rivals, can be ruled out.
runners.comment: Last of nine first time out in a race contested by four of these rivals, can be ruled out

runners.name: Siege Of Tyre
runners.spotlight: Has struggled in her first two races; will need a handicap mark to become competitive.
runners.comment: Has struggled in her first two races, will need a handicap mark to become competitive

races.race_name: Guidenstown Stud Irish EBF Maiden

runners.name: Shakespeare
runners.spotlight: One of three for trainer; shaped with promise on his C&D debut when coming home well for third despite greenness; failed to land 4-9 odds at Leopardstown last time when again betrayed by signs of inexperience; Moore keeps the faith and he's worth another chance.
runners.comment: Shaped with promise on debut but failed to land 4-9 odds last time; worth another chance

runners.name: The Captains Day
runners.spotlight: Acclamation colt; E90,000 2yo; fourth foal; half-brother to Qatari 7f 2yo winner Latifolia; dam unraced half-sister to 7f 2yo Listed winner Luna Royale, out of 7f 2yo Listed winning half-sister to 10.5f Group 3 winner Celimene; top rider booked so check market.
runners.comment: Half-brother to Qatari 7f 2yo winner; top rider booked so check market

runners.name: Anchor Road
runners.spotlight: Was an eyecatcher on debut over 6f here (good, 4-1) when he didn't get a clear passage before running on well for fifth; couldn't just evens favouritism over C&D last time when third and beaten by two newcomers; likely capable of better.
runners.comment: Positive fifth on debut but didn't justify favouritism last time; likely capable of more

runners.name: Lake Lugano
runners.spotlight: One of three for trainer; Starspangledbanner colt; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Agartha (7f/7.5f inc 2yo Group 2; RPR 111), Agathon (1m6f; 75) and Kahu (Italian 7f/1m inc sand); dam 11.7f-1m6f winner (inc Listed; 94), out of French 1m2f winning half-sister to 10.5f Group 1 winner Astarabad; stable's newcomers tend to improve over their initial outings.
runners.comment: Half-brother three winners inc' 2yo Gr.2 winner Agartha; check market

runners.name: Benown
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; Starspangledbanner colt; 90,000euros foal, 120,000gns yearling; fifth foal; half-brother to US 7.5f/1m turf winner Deccan Prince; dam French 10.5f winner, sister to 11.4f Flat and 2m/2m4f hurdle winner Refer, half-sister to 1m Listed winner Cinnamon Bay (dam of French Derby winner New Bay); Browne McMonagle chooses the yard's other debutant.
runners.comment: Half-brother to US winner; stable's other debutant appears the better fancied of the pair

runners.name: Loughrea N Roll
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; Lope De Vega colt; 145,000gns yearling; eleventh foal; brother to 7f AW 2yo/Group 3 winner Noble Champion (RPR 114), half-brother to five winners inc Pogo (7f/1m inc 2yo/Group 2; 118) and Birds Of Prey (9.5f-2m Flat, 102; 2m/2m3f hurdle); dam 2yo maiden, best effort at 7f (92); favoured by Browne McMonagle so not discounted.
runners.comment: Brother to Group 3 winner Noble Champion (RPR 114); McMonagle rides so not discounted

runners.name: Raging Bull
runners.spotlight: One of three for trainer; Wootton Bassett colt; seventh foal; half-brother to winners Precise (7f/1m inc 2yo/Irish 1,000 Guineas RPR 118), No Way It's Today (US 7f-1m turf) and Kodiaction (Swedish 7f-8.6f inc 2yo); dam placed 7f 2yo/1m1f (78), sister to 10.3f/1m6f Listed winner Kingfisher; top pedigree but may be one for the next day.
runners.comment: Half-brother to three winners inc' Irish Guineas winner Precise; Moore rides Shakespeare

runners.name: Romayan
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; Siyouni colt; fourth foal; half-brother to Listed-placed 10.3f winner Romzina (RPR 97); dam Listed-placed 1m4f winner (97), half-sister to winners Rajsaman (1m Group 2), Rosawa (1m Listed; dam of Marcel Boussac winner Rosanara) and Radanpour (1m4f Listed); market best guide on debut.
runners.comment: Half-brother to Listed-placed Romzina; dam Listed-placed too; market best guide
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Consenza
runners.spotlight: Coulsty colt; 60,000euros yearling; fourth foal; dam unplaced 6f-1m (RPR 70), half-sister to winners Bee Eater (useful 6f), Expedition (6.7f 2yo) and Rare Tern (8.5f), out of useful 5f/6f winning half-sister to top-class sprinter/miler Marling; best watched for now.
runners.comment: Coulsty colt was a 60,000euros yearling; dam unplaced; best watched

runners.name: Supreme Lord
runners.spotlight: Cost 400,000gns as a yearling; started 5-2 favourite for his Fairyhouse (6f, good) debut and ran a solid race when beaten just 1l; didn't really improve in Group 3 company at Leopardstown last time (7f, good); needs to find some improvement but that is certainly not ruled out and his experience is a plus.
runners.comment: Solid debut but didn't improve in a Gr.3 last time; experience a plus but needs more

runners.name: Fort Dearborn
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; positives to take from his C&D debut when 2.75l behind Anchor Road (good to firm, 25-1); a tongue tie goes on now and with improvement he could get involved.
runners.comment: Finished 2.75l behind Anchor Road on debut here; tongue tie on now
runners.owner: Samuel M Mencoff & Anthony Paul Smurfit

races.race_name: Sheehy Motors Volkswagen Handicap

runners.name: Prairie Girl
runners.spotlight: Thrived since joining this yard, three wins over 5f from six starts at Dundalk; progress stalled upped to 6f last time when last of ten; that run was too bad to be true and given a break since but she's up 29lb since her first win and needs to prove herself on turf now.
runners.comment: 3-6 at Dundalk since joining yard up 29lb; had break since bad run but must do it on turf
runners.owner: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan

runners.name: Finika
runners.spotlight: Made a low-key debut over 6.5f here but improved plenty to take the third spot at Cork next time (5f, good, 40-1); better again at 6f back at Cork (good to firm) last time when prevailing by 1l; her opening mark doesn't look too bad and she could play a role if her improvement continues.
runners.comment: Improved plenty over debut here to win at Cork; could play a role if improvement continues

runners.name: Rosie Frith
runners.spotlight: Scored for the third time when taking a Bellewstown handicap off 89 early last month (5f, good); solid efforts at Dundalk and Cork (5f, good to firm) since; just 1.25l behind Ipanema Queen latest; front runner is down 1lb and could go well.
runners.comment: Just 1.25l behind Ipanema Queen last time and down 1lb; could go well

runners.name: Erosandpsyche
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner was only beaten a short head by Ipanema Queen at Cork last time (5f, good to firm); nudged up 1lb but more concerning is that his runs at this track this term have been moderate; capable if things fall right though.
runners.comment: Beaten a short head by Ipanema Queen last time; runs here this term were moderate

runners.name: Headmaster
runners.spotlight: Added to two British 7f wins when bagging the Habitat Handicap (6f, good) here in May on second start for new yard; another solid display over 7f at Cork next time; never got involved after slipping coming out of the gates in the Scurry Handicap last time (6.5f, good to firm); firmly in the mix but not certain to appreciate this first try at the minimum trip.
runners.comment: Won the Habitat here in May; put line through latest when slipped; tries 5f for first time

runners.name: Focaccia
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt when scoring in a Bellewstown maiden (5f, good) last month; faded into seventh over C&D next time (good to firm) but didn't run too badly in a Naas Listed contest four days later (6f, good); second of five in a 6f Naas conditions race last time; drop back to 5f should suit but 2lb wrong.
runners.comment: M'den winner ovef 5f last month; okay runs last twice but 2lb wrong

runners.name: The Highway Rat
runners.spotlight: Best known for AW exploits, but is effective on turf; not a bad effort on seasonal return in the Habitat Handicap when 2.25l behind the winner Headmaster (6f, good); good second at Navan next time, but his latest two runs have been below-par, including when well beaten over 6.5f here last time; blinkers return and replace the visor worn that day.
runners.comment: Good efforts in opening two runs this season but below-par last twice; more needed

runners.name: Sarahmae
runners.spotlight: Has been in career-best form this season, winning back-to-back handicaps over 5f at Cork (good) and Down Royal (soft) before just failing to catch Genesis in the Rockingham Handicap over C&D in June; returned to handicap company at Cork last time when a creditable fifth (1.75l behind the winner Ipanema Queen); claimer is yet to win from 15 starts.
runners.comment: Career-best form this season; neck behind Genesis over C&D in June; okay effort latest
runners.owner: Mary B Hogan & Michael M O'Brien

runners.name: Arugam Bay
runners.spotlight: Made all to win a small-field Listed event at Tipperary last July (5f, good); two defeats afterwards came over 6f in Group 3 company; made seasonal return in a Listed race at Bath in April (5f, good) but was well beaten; makes handicap debut now and rider's 7lb claim is a help.
runners.comment: Small-field Listed winner; well beaten on return; rider's claim a help on h'cap bow

runners.name: Genesis
runners.spotlight: Has been in the form of his life this season; won over 6f here on seasonal return and bagged another victory in a C&D premier handicap in June despite being 3lb out of the weights; didn't quite see out the 6.5f trip of the Scurry handicap here last month, but it was still a blinding run to finish third; went too quick at Cork last time; definite chance.
runners.comment: In the form of his life this season winning twice here; firmly in the mix

runners.name: Cuban Grey
runners.spotlight: Admirable sort with seven wins and 17 places to his name; struggled in two turf starts in the first half of June following a Dundalk win; outran his 33-1 odds when fourth behind Genesis over C&D latest.
runners.comment: Admirable seven-time winner; outran 33-1 odds when fourth behind Genesis here latest

runners.name: Chicago Call
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner over 6f last year had been running mostly in stakes company until making his handicap debut at Cork last time (5f, good to firm) when eighth of 11 and behind a few of these; dropped 3lb but more needed.
runners.comment: M'den winner made h'cap debut last time when behind a few of these; more needed down 3lb
runners.owner: Samuel M Mencoff & Anthony Paul Smurfit

races.race_name: FBD Hotels And Resorts Phoenix Sprint Stakes (Group 3)

runners.name: Big Mojo
runners.spotlight: Won the Sprint Cup at Haydock last season when his form also featured a fine second in the July Cup; towards the rear in this year's edition of the Newmarket showpiece last month; previously found 5f a bit sharp in the King Charles III Stakes at Royal Ascot; best treated at the weights but questions to answer.
runners.comment: Top-class sprinting form last season, best treated at the weights but questions to answer

runners.name: Bodhi Bear
runners.spotlight: Smart handicap form this season. also a fine third behind Big Gossey in a C&D Listed race on his penultimate start; not one of his better handicap displays on latest.
runners.comment: Smart handicap form this season, also a fine third behind Big Gossey in a C&D Listed race

runners.name: Big Gossey
runners.spotlight: Course specialist made it ten wins here with a Listed race success over this trip in June; also won the Gladness Stakes over 7f here in March; second to subsequent Group 1 winner Comanche Brave in the Greenlands in May, with James Delight in third; holding his form admirably on the evidence of Group 2 second over 7f here three weeks ago.
runners.comment: The great course-specialist continues to thrive, two seconds in Group 2 races this term

runners.name: James's Delight
runners.spotlight: Won last year's Greenlands Stakes here, battling well to beat another British challenger, with Big Gossey a little unlucky in a close third; struggled in two Group 1s in the autumn; out of the money on seasonal debut at Doncaster in March; more like it in his repeat bid in the Greenlands, splitting Big Gossey and Bucanero Fuerte; relatively light campaign may stand to him now.
runners.comment: Split Big Gossey and Bucanero Fuerte over C&D in May when failing to repeat a 2025 triumph

runners.name: Bucanero Fuerte
runners.spotlight: Former top-class juvenile, six-time winner, four at this track, including the 2023 Phoenix Stakes and this race last year; finished behind Big Gossey and James Delight when fourth in the Greenlands here in May; failed to make much impact over 5f here last time; capable of a big run on his day.
runners.comment: Most recent win was in this last year, behind Big Gossey and James Delight here in May
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Giselle De Aguiar

races.race_name: Keeneland Phoenix Stakes (Group 1) (No Geldings)

runners.name: Celeron
runners.spotlight: Refused to enter the stalls on his intended debut at Navan; made a good impression over C&D at the beginning of June; missed the break in the Windsor Castle won by King Of Cloughran; left that form far behind when beating Tribeca comprehensively in the Railway Stakes; not short of speed but looks like a type who will stay further than this.
runners.comment: Missed the break at Royal Ascot, fine effort when beating Tribeca in the Railway Stakes

runners.name: Sun Goddess
runners.spotlight: Just denied on debut at Naas; impressive when beating Green Empress by 5l over C&D next time; well backed when a close second in the Albany Stakes at Royal Ascot; a snug odds-on winner of a Group 2 here only eight days later; Aidan O'Brien has won this 17 times, but only once since 2017 and never with a filly; hard to oppose all the same.
runners.comment: Beaten by a talented filly in the Albany Stakes, has since won a C&D Group 2 comfortably

runners.name: Velozee
runners.spotlight: Made it 2-2 with a smooth success in a four-runner 5f Listed race here in May; faded in a 6f Group 3 at Naas next time; kept on well when eighth of 27 in the Group 2 Queen Mary at the Royal Ascot; third in a recent Group 3 at Ascot; this is demanding for a 97-rated filly.
runners.comment: 5f Listed winer at this venue, third in a recent Group 3 at Ascot, this is very demanding
runners.owner: Gary Matthews, Steve Weston & Lucky Hat

runners.name: King Of Cloughan
runners.spotlight: Twice in the frame on home soil before bringing off a 33-1 shock in the Windsor Castle, getting up late after meeting a lot of trouble on running; did not look entirely straightforward when beaten by the sole French-trained runner in the Group 2 Prix Robert Papin at Chantilly.
runners.comment: Windsor Castle winner, beaten by the sole French-trained runner in a Group 2 at Chantilly

runners.name: Carry The Flag
runners.spotlight: Not especially convincing when landing the odds over 5f at Naas on second start; much sharper next time over C&D when second to the subsequent Coventry winner Great Barrier Reef; beaten 7l in ninth when 5-2 favourite in the Norfolk; got up late to win a 5f Listed race at Naas; finished in the rear in the Railway Stakes won by Celeron, up against it.
runners.comment: 5f Listed winner, finished in rear in the Railway Stakes won by Celeron, up against it

runners.name: Folsom Blues
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise over C&D in May on debut; showed the benefit of the run with an emphatic maiden over 7f at Gowran in June; split two Aidan O'Brien-trained runners when second in the Group 3 Tyros Stakes over 7f at Leopardstown; might find this a bit sharp, though the champion jockey sticks with him.
runners.comment: Might find this a bit sharp following maiden win and Group 3 second both over 7f

runners.name: The Scallionator
runners.spotlight: Listowel maiden winner or his third outing; out of his depth in the Coventry; outran his 50-1 odds when fourth in the Railway Stakes; admirable sort but held by Celeron and Tribeca.
runners.comment: Outran his 50-1 odds when fourth in the Railway Stakes, held by Celeron and Tribeca

runners.name: Tribeca
runners.spotlight: Form of debut win at Navan has worked out; finished behind Carry The Flag in the Norfolk; beaten decisively by Celeron in the Railway Stakes and may struggle to turn the tables.
runners.comment: Beaten decisively by Celeron in the Railway Stakes and may struggle to turn the tables
runners.owner: AMO Racing Limited & Mrs A O'Callaghan

races.race_name: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap

runners.name: Mint Man
runners.spotlight: AW winner got off the mark on turf at Naas this time last year (6f, good to yielding) off 5lb lower; ran his best race this term when a 2l third of ten back at Naas last time (6f, good); new headgear combination tried; hasn't run too badly at this track in the past.
runners.comment: Dual winner ran best race this term at Naas last time when third; has run okay here before

runners.name: Lohoobb
runners.spotlight: Remained a maiden after seven starts for Owen Burrows (beaten favourite in all four handicap starts for former yard this season); purchased for 35,0000gns last month and it wasn't a bad stable debut when a 5l fourth of 11 at Naas (6f, good, 16-1) last time.
runners.comment: Beaten favourite in all four h'caps for Owen Burrows; not a bad stable debut latest

runners.name: Hugo's Girl
runners.spotlight: Now an 18-race maiden but several good placed efforts; close second of 21 over 5f at Navan (winner won again since) in June; fast finishing fourth at Fairyhouse last month when not getting a clear run (6f, good); just 0.75l behind the winner when fourth again at Fairyhouse last time (7f, good); up 3lb more but top rider booked.
runners.comment: 0-18 but several good placed efforts; top rider booked and should go close once again

runners.name: Nouvel Espoir
runners.spotlight: Gained fourth win of his career at Down Royal (5f, soft) in June; followed his wins with two solid close-up fourths over 5f at Naas and here last time; mark remains unchanged but all his best efforts have been over 5f.
runners.comment: Gained fourth career win in June; solid efforts twice since; 6f trip a question
runners.owner: Ms Yvonne Hennessy & Ms S O'Neill

runners.name: All Hail
runners.spotlight: His best maiden run came at the third attempt last season when a 3l second of 14 at Navan (6f, good); beaten 30l at Fairyhouse on seasonal return/handicap debut; close-up fourth of ten at Navan (5f, good) was much better next time; another deplorable effort at Naas last time when last of 10; blinkers on but not a trustworthy character.
runners.comment: Okay effort at Navan this term is sandwiched between two deplorable ones; hard to trust

runners.name: Aurora Nova
runners.spotlight: Four wins have all been on fast tracks, including last year at Bellewstown (twice) and Down Royal over 5f; standout run this term at former venue when third (5f, soft); never counted in two most recent runs at Navan over 6f; opposable.
runners.comment: Four-time winner on fast tracks; never counted in two most recent runs at Navan; opposable

runners.name: Nazario
runners.spotlight: Placed in several maidens last season at 6f-1m; fine return to action at Fairyhouse (6f, good) in June when a luckless fourth; didn't improve over 7f at Galway last time when a distant fourth (yielding); ran poorly in sole start at this venue in a 7f handicap last season; new headgear combination tried.
runners.comment: Good fourth on return but didn't improve last time; ran poorly in sole start here

runners.name: Beat The Devil
runners.spotlight: 1m AW winner off 12lb lower has run poorly in all six starts on turf; back on the level after some moderate efforts over hurdles; unlikely.
runners.comment: 1m AW winner has run poorly in all six starts on turf; moderate runs over hurdles recently

runners.name: Caislean Ni Cuan
runners.spotlight: Has been keen in all three of her maidens over 7f but has shown signs of promise all the same; drops to 6f for her handicap debut now which may help; not totally ruled out.
runners.comment: Keen in all three of her 7f m'dens but some promise shown; drops to 6f for h'cap bow

runners.name: Rosato
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner over 6f on yielding and good ground; just fair efforts in her opening three runs this term before going down by a neck at Cork last time (6f, good to firm) under today's rider; she's 1lb wrong despite a 4lb rise for the last day, but has won from a higher mark in the past.
runners.comment: Three-time 6f winner went down by a neck last time; 1lb wrong but has won off higher

runners.name: Yutori
runners.spotlight: Has raced exclusively on AW since two moderate efforts in opening maidens, including over C&D; improved form when second in a 10.5f maiden at Dundalk in January in first-time cheekpieces; they didn't have the same effect over the same trip in a handicap next time; others more likely.
runners.comment: Improved form when second in an AW m'den in Jan' but poor in h'cap next time

runners.name: Sovereign Cry
runners.spotlight: 5f Dundalk winner last season; stepped up on previous form when winning at Naas last month (5f, good), third won next time out; didn't run too badly over 5f here last time off his 5lb higher mark when a 2.75l eighth of 18 (5f, good to firm); Foley takes over from 7lb claimer now.
runners.comment: Added to AW win when successful off 5lb lower at Naas on penultimate; eighths here latest
runners.owner: John B O'Hagan & Mrs John Murphy

runners.name: Gerrit's Gem
runners.spotlight: All three wins for Kieran Cotter came at Cork (6f-1m); a long way below his best in three runs for new yard this term; others preferred.
runners.comment: All three wins came at Cork for former yard; long way below his best this term

runners.name: Go Athletico
runners.spotlight: Nine-time turf winner, including a 6f Group 3 in 2023; has also won at Listed level and was once rated 108, so has dropped a long way; good efforts over this trip and 6.5f here recently and even better at Galway last time when a close second of 15 (7f, yielding); had things in his favour that day but should remain competitive off 4lb higher.
runners.comment: Nine-time winner was once rated 108; good efforts here recently and at Galway latest

races.race_name: Money Back Daily Specials With Tote.ie Handicap

runners.name: Marmeladova
runners.spotlight: Added to her Ballinrobe maiden win over an extended 1m1f trip when landing a 1m2f Leopardstown handicap by a neck last time (good); she was probably value for more than the winning distance that day and should be competitive off just 3lb higher but the drop to 1m is a slight negative.
runners.comment: Landed 1m2f h'cap off 3lb lower last time; should be competitive but drops to 1m

runners.name: Kalir
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt in maiden company at Killarney last time (1m, good), his second run since being gelded; raced keenly that day but kept on well to win; not ruled out on his handicap debut.
runners.comment: Off the mark at sixth attempt in m'den company latest; not ruled out on h'cap bow
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Summer Island
runners.spotlight: In fine form this year; AW winner in February has raced three times at this track, winning twice over 7f and finishing second once over C&D; up 5lb for her latest win here last time (7f, good) under today's rider; could post another bold bid.
runners.comment: AW winner is 2-3 at the track inc' when winning off 5lb lower last time; bold bid expected
runners.owner: Nigel O'Hare & Martin W White & Mark Devlin & C G Bryson

runners.name: Glitter And Glory
runners.spotlight: Rarely runs a bad race; won a 7f maiden at Dundalk in March; some decent runs in defeat on turf since; second in a five-runner conditions race at Leopardstown over this trip in June and took the third spot at Killarney in a handicap off this mark next time; fifth of sixth but only 2.75l away from the winner over C&D last time; 1lb wrong but should run her race.
runners.comment: Consistent filly has run some decent races in defeat on turf since winning AW m'den

runners.name: Goal Exceeded
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; up 10lb compared to his Leopardstown win in June (7f, good); ran with credit off his revised mark at Galway last time when fourth of 15 (7f, yielding); upped to 1m now and should give a good account of himself again.
runners.comment: Up 10b compared to his win in June but ran with credit off revised mark last time
runners.owner: B White & M W White & D Sheridan & Ms H McGuinness

runners.name: No More Porter
runners.spotlight: One of two for trainer; all three wins have come here, including one over C&D; 8lb below his last winning mark from 2024; good placed form on good ground over 1m here in June and at Killarney and Gowran last month; yielding to soft ground a possible excuse when disappointing at Galway last time; he could have a big run in him with Keane aboard for the first time.
runners.comment: All three wins have come here and has shown good placed form recently; can go well

runners.name: Dark Viper
runners.spotlight: All three wins have come at Leopardstown, including last time over 1m1f (good) when a comfortable victor after being allowed to dictate the pace; 5lb rise for that seems fair enough and he's in good form but must win away from his preferred track.
runners.comment: All three wins came at Leopardstown inc' latest; up 5lb but in good form

runners.name: Booyea
runners.spotlight: Last win came in a valuable C&D handicap in June 2024 off 88; best run for almost a year came in the same event here last time in first-time blinkers (retained), with 3l back to Playin Cool; 5lb rise for that is perhaps a tad harsh but winner ran well twice at Galway; firmly in the mix.
runners.comment: Last win came in C&D h'cap in 2024 off 88; up 5lb for second in same event latest

runners.name: Final Voyage
runners.spotlight: Ended a long losing sequence with a 10.5f Cork win in April under this rider (good to yielding) off 3lb lower; didn't appreciate drop back to 7f back at Cork the following month (short head behind Dark Viper); never better than midfield over this trip at Naas when last seen; others preferred.
runners.comment: Ended a long losing sequence in April; moderate efforts twice since

runners.name: Howyoulikethat
runners.spotlight: Last of five wins was in 2023; not the force he was, though has run well at times; fair third of eight in a Killarney handicap last month but well beaten in a premier Galway handicap last time (1m1f, yielding); others preferred.
runners.comment: Not the force of old; fair third on penultimate but well beaten in a premier h'cap latest
runners.owner: Just The Two Of Us Partnership

races.race_name: WTW Willis Mares Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Shoda
runners.spotlight: Decent mare on the Flat at up to 2m; 0-7 hurdling however, placed in maidens last winter but recent comeback run at Galway was a long way below her best; this looks a weaker maiden, though, so definite claims.
runners.comment: Recent Galway run well below her best, leading claims however on previous form

runners.name: Lilannbee
runners.spotlight: Useful bumper performer, sole win coming when making all at Punchestown in December (yielding), well held twice afterwards in winners' contests; back from a break for hurdles debut last month, let down by jumping when respectable fourth in 2m4f Wexford mares' maiden (good); entitled to improve for that run.
runners.comment: Bumper winner let down by jumping on recent hurdles debut at Wexford; can come on for that

runners.name: Tubberfinn Lassie
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in a pair of point-to-points last October; can only be watched on rules debut.
runners.comment: Pulled up in a pair of point-to-points last October; can only be watched on rules debut

runners.name: Clanokre Lass
runners.spotlight: Fair form on debut in Clonmel bumper in May and returned there following month when fair fourth in 2m1f maiden hurdle (good); good bit more needed here.
runners.comment: Fair fourth in Clonmel maiden in June; good bit more needed here

runners.name: Santa Paula
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced mare with little to recommend until much improved in 2m Kilbeggan mares' maiden last month, staying from some way back to finish third (good) - sixth has won since; slightly longer trip to suit and remains capable of better; respected.
runners.comment: Strong-finishing Kilbeggan third should relish longer trip; likely more to come

runners.name: Greenroad Girl
runners.spotlight: Order Of St George filly is first foal of a modest half-sister to winners Early Morning Rain (bumper and 2m/2m1f hurdle), Rosa Damascena (1m2f) and Matavia Bay (1m2f); pulled up after never featuring on hurdles debut last month at Killarney; can only be watched.
runners.comment: Pulled up after never featuring on hurdles debut last month at Killarney

runners.name: Searcog
runners.spotlight: Modest Flat winner is 0-5 hurdling although creditable effort on latest when decent fourth of 20 in 2m1f Galway handicap last month (good); place claims back in maiden company.
runners.comment: Decent fourth of 20 in 2n1f Galway handicap last month; place claims back in a maiden

races.race_name: Randox Rated Hurdle

runners.name: Chanceawetmorning
runners.spotlight: Progressive for Gordon Elliott, winning three of five starts; handicaps at Kilbeggan and Clonmel and 3-runner 2m4f Roscommon novice; disappointing favourite however back in handicap over C&D in June when forcing tactics employed, fading badly once headed approaching the last in contest won by Malbay Madness; back from a break with questions to answer.
runners.comment: Progressive until C&D flop in June; back from a break with questions to answer

runners.name: Trasna Na Pairce
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner at Clonmel (2m4f/2m6f) is yet to score over fences but has posted several solid runs in defeat; two recent Wexford efforts were well below best, however, and now reverts to hurdles with blinkers tried.
runners.comment: Below best chasing last twice; reverts to hurdles with blinkers tried

runners.name: Malbay Madness
runners.spotlight: Progressive 6yo gained a third Kilbeggan win in May before landing C&D handicap success following month (Chanceawetmorning a disappointing favourite); Bellewstown run was disappointing but has to be respected on overall profile.
runners.comment: C&D winner disappointed since at Bellewstown but has to be respected on overall profile

runners.name: Tribal Moon
runners.spotlight: Dual 1m AW winner for former yard and went close on yard debut at Dundalk in November; modest enough form in four attempts hurdling, most recently poor Flat effort at Galway last month; seemingly lots to find.
runners.comment: AW winner but hurdles form leaves him with a lot to find here

runners.name: Shinnhill
runners.spotlight: C&D maiden winner two years ago for this trainer; has had just two outings since, latest when pulled up after losing touch three out in 2m Kilbeggan handicap won by Malbay Madness in May; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 9yo a C&D winner in 2024 but hard to fancy at these weights

races.race_name: Lily O'Hare Memorial Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Gortmore Lady
runners.spotlight: Maiden was placed on a few occasions when trained by Tony Martin; first effort of note for current yard when third of 15 over C&D last month, losing second on run-in (good) in first-time cheekpieces; tongue-tie added here.
runners.comment: Encouraging C&D third last month; tongue-tie added and place claims again

runners.name: Parkgarve
runners.spotlight: Maiden over both hurdles and fences, placed twice in C&D handicap hurdles last year including second in this race off 96; handicap chase form of late below best and blinkers now added to usual tongue-tie for hurdles return.
runners.comment: Last year's second off 6lb higher; below best chasing of late, blinkers now added

runners.name: Granlahan
runners.spotlight: Placed three times over hurdles, notably third over this trip at Sligo in June (good); didn't appear to stay 2m6f at Ballinrobe on latest, so don't rule out back in trip here.
runners.comment: Didn't appear to stay 2m6f at Ballinrobe on latest, so don't rule out back in trip here

runners.name: Tropical Twist
runners.spotlight: Twice finished well in 2m1f Wexford handicaps before off the mark in similar mares' contest on Friday, showing good attitude from last to finish clear with the runner-up (good); carries mandatory 7lb penalty.
runners.comment: Friday's Wexford winner carries mandatory 7lb penalty; big player if turning out again

runners.name: Kalsman
runners.spotlight: Two course wins, over 2m6f and more recently over 2m4f in April; okay chase debut here in June and has had a break since; back hurdling and this trip looks on the short side.
runners.comment: Dual course winner over further; back from a break and trip is on the short side

runners.name: Pralognan
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose 7yo who won C&D handicap hurdle last summer off 92; absent since November so may need this, but jockey/trainer going well and any market strength worth noting.
runners.comment: C&D winner last summer; lacks a recent run so may need this, but watch market

runners.name: Mount Hotham
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden has yet to make an impact in handicap hurdles, hanging badly right on home turn at Wexford last time; hard to be confident in, although Danny Mullins booking a positive.
runners.comment: Yet to make an impact in handicaps, hanging badly right on home turn at Wexford on latest

runners.name: Fine Print
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner is 0-6 hurdling, never counting in 2m4f Sligo handicap last month; 3lb lower but big improvement needed.
runners.comment: Never counted in 2m4f Sligo handicap last month; 3lb lower but big improvement needed

runners.name: Leitzel
runners.spotlight: Flat winner is now 0-12 hurdling, couple of poor runs at Down Royal earlier in the year for this yard; hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Couple of poor runs at Down Royal earlier in the year for this yard; hard to fancy

races.race_name: Franco Hughes Away Bet Mares Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Poetic Twist
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner over this trip at Tramore and closely matched with Samba Train on run before at Killarney; remote second over 2m3f at Kilbeggan, but third left that form behind when winning readily at Galway; handicap debut.
runners.comment: Maiden winner over this trip at Tramore; closely matched with Samba Train on run before

runners.name: Samba Train
runners.spotlight: Dual bumper winner and beat Poetic Twist by a neck in Killarney maiden hurdle over a little farther than this; only 6-1 for 20-runner 2m handicap at Galway, exited at halfway.
runners.comment: Dual bumper and Killarney maiden hurdle winner; only 6-1 when exited halfway at Galway

runners.name: Gangster Granny
runners.spotlight: A revelation at this venue in recent months; two wins and a second from last four outings, all over this trip; up 8lb for last month's victory.
runners.comment: Two wins and a second from last four runs, all over C&D; up 8lb for last month's victory

runners.name: Cobra Queen
runners.spotlight: Likeable type was dual winning hurdler in 2024 and two chase wins last year; good third over hurdles at Killarney (2m7f) when tried in cheekpieces and has good record at this time of year.
runners.comment: Dual winning hurdler in 2024 and two chase wins last year; good third at Killarney (2m7f)

runners.name: Oh Janey
runners.spotlight: Won over shorter trip here in October; stumbled badly in the dip when only a length off Joya Del Mar over C&D on just her second outing of the year.
runners.comment: Won over shorter trip here in October; only a length off Joya Del Mar when fifth over C&D

runners.name: Joya Del Mar
runners.spotlight: Another that goes well here with pair of C&D wins this summer; beat Gangster Granny two runs back and now meets her on 7lb better terms (including claims); beaten 3l on latest visit.
runners.comment: Another that goes well here with pair of C&D wins this summer; beaten 3l latest visit
runners.owner: Mrs T Giles-Fahey & Miss S Mangan

runners.name: Miss Lia
runners.spotlight: Last couple of runs not her best but she's been runner-up four times in handicaps, including over C&D in March; would probably prefer easier terrain.
runners.comment: Last couple of runs not her best but she was runner-up over C&D in March; likes an ease
runners.owner: Sussex By The Sea Syndicate/David L'Estrange

runners.name: Billie Frechette
runners.spotlight: Had a good time last summer, winning on the level and over hurdles, second over 2m2f here as well; was reverting from three runs over fences when beaten 37l over 2m at Galway.
runners.comment: Was reverting from three runs over fences when beaten 37l over 2m at Galway

runners.name: Theflyingbee
runners.spotlight: Won over 2m3f here last year and consistent efforts over 2m in the spring; back from a break and steps back up in trip; stays 2m4f well.
runners.comment: Won over 2m3f here last year and consistent efforts over 2m in the spring; back up in trip

runners.name: Camlin Park
runners.spotlight: Pulled up twice after maiden win here last August; after a break, was huge price when running well at Galway, staying on to be 15l seventh in 20-runner mares' handicap.
runners.comment: Pulled up twice after maiden win here last August; huge price when ran well at Galway

races.race_name: J Murdoch Contracts Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Magical Sal
runners.spotlight: Ran okay in a bumper here and much improved on second attempt in maiden hurdles when chasing home a ready 4l winner in C&D maiden last month (good); respected.
runners.comment: C&D second last month makes her a major contender

runners.name: Lygon Lad
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in 2m Navan handicap in late 2024 (yielding-to-soft) the nearest he's got; fair fourth in 2m4f Down Royal novice handicap following year (good) but soon beaten following month in similar Fairyhouse contest; returns from 16 months' absence.
runners.comment: Bits and pieces of form, but returning from long absence

runners.name: Young Doran
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to three winners over distances from 2m3f-3m; nibbled at big odds on debut in extended 2m6f maiden at Ballinrobe in late May, coming from rear to finish 6l second; won't have to improve too much to go one better here.
runners.comment: Ballinrobe debut second over this trip marks him out as the one to beat

runners.name: Thesilverbridle
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to smart 2m1f-2m4f hurdler/chaser Senecia; dam 2m4f-3m hurdle/chase winner; won Rathcannon point-to-point in April (soft) and encouraging hurdles debut at Wexford when staying on into second on run-in (having hung right) over 2m4f; step up in trip should suit and one to consider.
runners.comment: Wexford debut second was promising and longer trip here should suit; contender

runners.name: Paymelater
runners.spotlight: Placed twice in bumpers; mildly encouraging hurdles debut in 2m3f maiden here in June (good) but poor effort at Bellewstown last month; eligible for a mark after today.
runners.comment: Mildly encouraging hurdles debut here in June, but looks more one for a handicap

runners.name: G N Jefferson
runners.spotlight: British point-to-point form nothing to shout about, nor his run in an Aintree bumper; second maiden hurdle run at Kilbeggan was a small step forward, but still plenty more likely required here and tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Kilbeggan run a small step forward but still plenty more likely required; tongue-tie added

runners.name: That's It Paddy
runners.spotlight: Twice ran in point-to-points before hurdles debut in May, leading to beyond halfway before dropping away; may need more time.
runners.comment: Well held on hurdles debut in May; may need more time

races.race_name: Join Us For Ladies Day Handicap Hurdle

runners.name: Sneddy Eddie
runners.spotlight: Winning miler has been around the houses; best run in three handicap hurdle starts was 6l fifth at Wexford on stable debut; not as good twice since and query over his stamina for this far.
runners.comment: Best run in three handicap hurdle starts was 6l fifth at Wexford on stable debut

runners.name: Georgia Celena
runners.spotlight: First, third and second in three C&D handicaps last year; good return to action in June when third to Joya Del Mar over C&D and touched off over 3m at Wexford last month; little to dislike.
runners.comment: Fine record over C&D and touched off over 3m at Wexford last month; little to dislike

runners.name: Sineads Fancy
runners.spotlight: Sole win was off 84 in 2024 edition of this; just one placed effort in 11 starts since; not a bad run under King last time when beaten 11l over this trip at Ballinrobe.
runners.comment: Sole win was off 84 in 2024 edition of this; just one placed effort in 11 starts since

runners.name: Something Simple
runners.spotlight: Bumper form was okay; little of note hurdling until Limerick fourth in May (2m6f, soft); weakened over 3m latest; headgear and top jockey.
runners.comment: Little of note hurdling until Limerick fourth in May (2m6f, soft); weakened over 3m latest
runners.owner: Something Simple Syndicate/J C Hurley Et Al

runners.name: Ballinagaine Girl
runners.spotlight: One of three for the 'Shark'; three handicap starts, lapped either of side of well-ridden 7-1 Limerick second (rider went wide for drier ground); hard to know.
runners.comment: Three handicap starts, lapped either of side of well-ridden 7-1 Limerick second

runners.name: My Good Pal
runners.spotlight: Consistent over hurdles last year, gaining sole win over extended 2m4f at Wexford; chasing this summer, second over farther here in in May and good run at Kilbeggan last time; cheekpieces return.
runners.comment: Consistent over hurdles last year, gaining sole win over extended 2m4f at Wexford

runners.name: Bob The Builder
runners.spotlight: Won a couple of points for Sean Doyle and pair of okay runs in Wexford handicaps last year for Richie Rath; tailed off at Cork last month; stable debut.
runners.comment: Okay runs in Wexford handicaps last year for Richie Rath; tailed off at Cork last month

runners.name: Hay Baby
runners.spotlight: Point winner had some okay handicap runs, when hooded and fairly well fancied, for Peter Fahey last year; best effort was fourth of 18 over 2m4f at Listowel festival; two poor runs over 3m this year, including last month's stable debut (only 11-2, no headgear); hood back on and tongue-tie added.
runners.comment: Some okay handicap runs, when hooded and fairly well fancied, for Peter Fahey; tongue-tie

runners.name: Sonna Lady
runners.spotlight: Homebred filly by Golden Lariat; beaten 30l on debut and twice tailed off since; first handicap.
runners.comment: Homebred filly by Golden Lariat; beaten 30l on debut and twice tailed off since

runners.name: Speakasyoufind
runners.spotlight: Nice pedigree and shrewd owners; first time to be a single-figure price when second to subsequent winner at Clonmel where he was staying on over 2m3f; probably wants to go this way, so given a pass for Killarney sixth.
runners.comment: First time to be a single-figure price was when second to  subsequent winner at Clonmel

races.race_name: Alan Dunlop, 90th Birthday INH Flat Race

runners.name: Martymill
runners.spotlight: Fair level of form in five starts; best runs were debut fourth at Fairyhouse and 2m4f second (first-time cheekpieces) at Listowel in June; beaten 16l over 2m2f at Galway last time, but that was a good race.
runners.comment: Fair level of form; beaten 16l over 2m2f at Galway last time, but that was a good race.

runners.name: Vargas
runners.spotlight: Vadamos gelding cost £22,000 as 3yo; half-brother to winners The Four Sixes (useful 2m-2m5f hurdle/chase), Innovated (2m hurdle/2m4f chase), King Of Strings (bumper/2m hurdle), Cobra Angel (3m hurdle) and Flemencello (bumper); dam 2m hurdle winner; 7-2 and 5s when pulled up in both points last year for Cormac Doyle; no surprise if he's competitive.
runners.comment: 7-2 and 5s when pulled up in both points for Cormac Doyle; no surprise if he's competitive

runners.name: Culldoo
runners.spotlight: Homebred Doctor Dino filly from good French family, dam won over 1m6f; 6-4 fav, pushed along 4f out before sticking to her task when third in 2m2f mares' bumper here in May; not much of note behind her, but winner showed the form in a good light next time.
runners.comment: 6-4 fav, pushed along 4f out before staying on when third in mares' bumper here in May

runners.name: Loves A Laugh
runners.spotlight: Vadamos filly from useful staying family; 25s, going nowhere 4f out on debut over C&D, and then ran green, before staying on well up the hill to be beaten around 6l behind the two market principals; owner's daughter rides again.
runners.comment: 25s, going nowhere 4f out on debut over C&D, and then ran green, before staying on well

runners.name: Tommy's Ticket
runners.spotlight: Not wild prices when beaten 6.75l both starts; pushed wide home turn at Ballinrobe last time before keeping on in fair-looking contest; another 3f to travel here.
runners.comment: Not wild prices when beaten 6.75l both starts; might appreciate going an extra 3f here

runners.name: Greenmeansgo
runners.spotlight: Belated debut for Green Moon gelding; dam maiden pointer, sister to 2m5f chase winner Melua Maid; yard doesn't win bumpers.
runners.comment: Green Moon gelding; dam maiden pointer, sister to 2m5f chase winner Melua Maid

races.race_name: Loros - Irish EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Al Wathba
runners.spotlight: 900,000euros yearling who went off 4-1 when faring best of the newcomers in second at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) last month, behind subsequent Vintage Stakes runner-up Haffner; this Godolphin colt has very strong claims.
runners.comment: Second to subsequent Vintage Stakes runner-up at Newmarket on debut; very strong claims

runners.name: Jimtrott
runners.spotlight: Beaten a head on debut at Newbury (6.5f, good to soft) in June and 4l second there (6f, good to firm) since; should be winning sooner rather than later but faces a tough opponent in Al Wathba this afternoon.
runners.comment: Runner-up on both starts; faces a tough opponent in Al Wathba this afternoon

runners.name: Ebt's Warrior
runners.spotlight: 65,000euros yearling; ninth foal; half-brother to winners Corazon (5f 2yo including Group 3), Savvy Disko (1m/1m1f; RPR 95), She Can Boogie (5f including 2yo; 94), Twafeeg (6.5f 2yo; 87) and Happy Tears (6f AW; 81); dam 5f 2yo winner (91); likely to improve for this first run but bred to be a talented 2yo and yard did have a 2yo newcomer win at 12-1 at Salisbury in June.
runners.comment: Likely to improve for this first run but bred to be a talented 2yo

races.race_name: Catalogue Engineering Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Greek Symphony
runners.spotlight: She's improved with each of her three runs, going close at Newbury (6f, good to firm) on second start then winning at Lingfield (7f, AW); could continue to progress and she's one to consider.
runners.comment: Won at Lingfield (7f, AW) on third start and could continue to progress; one to consider

runners.name: Bayside
runners.spotlight: Won at Beverley (5f, good to soft) in April on the second of her five starts and ran well when third at Kempton (7f, AW) last month on her nursery debut, coming from further back than the first two; could have more to offer.
runners.comment: Ran well when third on nursery debut at Kempton and could have more to offer
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Civ & B R Millman

runners.name: Jazzy Bay
runners.spotlight: Kept on for 2l third of seven on nursery debut at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) last month and ran okay when fourth of ten at Ffos Las (7.3f, good) recently; however, he was no match for the first three last time; needs to find something extra and he could do with breaking better.
runners.comment: No match for the first three when fourth in recent nursery at Ffos Las

runners.name: Katie's Cavalier
runners.spotlight: He's raced four times and, after being gelded, he achieved his best result when fourth of sixth at Chester (7f, good) a fortnight ago; has more realistic claims in this first nursery but not obviously well treated.
runners.comment: He's raced four times; yet to finish better than fourth and not obviously well treated

runners.name: Better Nature
runners.spotlight: Yet to threaten but showed ability when third in C&D maiden (good) in June and also when near-8l second at Brighton (7f, good to firm) last month; the form of his course run suggests he may have potential off his opening mark and he could have a part to play.
runners.comment: Nursery debut; third in C&D maiden two starts ago and he may have potential off this mark

runners.name: Love Rome
runners.spotlight: Encouraging third on debut at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) in June and close second at Ayr (7f, good to firm) since; the Ayr winner followed up in a nursery, suggesting this fellow could be on a good mark on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Close 2nd on second start and the winner followed up in a nursery; could be on a good mark

races.race_name: TLC Teddies For Loving Care Handicap

runners.name: Al Maslool
runners.spotlight: He'd been knocking at the door prior to getting off the mark at the eighth attempt in a handicap at Chester (1m4f, good) a fortnight ago; did well to get up having had to be switched and he's just 2lb higher today; could have more to offer for top yard and he's in calculations.
runners.comment: Did well to get up at Chester having had to be switched and he's just 2lb higher today

runners.name: Robusto
runners.spotlight: Won at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) in April and close third at Chester (1m4f, good) four weeks ago; this 6yo could give another good account but is taking on some unexposed 3yos and may well be vulnerable.
runners.comment: Close third at Chester four weeks ago but this 6yo takes on some unexposed 3yos today

runners.name: Barak Warrior
runners.spotlight: Made handicap debut at Bath (11.6f, firm) last month over a new trip having been gelded and he won by 2l; that form has worked out well and he could still be ahead of the handicapper following a 7lb rise.
runners.comment: 2l win on h'cap debut at Bath & that form has worked out well; could still be well treated
runners.owner: W Sweatman, J Summers, R Foden

runners.name: Sahm Naif
runners.spotlight: Won by a short head at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) in June and followed up by a neck in first-time cheekpieces at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm); fifth of six at Nottingham (1m1f, good to firm) since but finished close up and it's possible the switch to blinkers will eke out something extra.
runners.comment: Won 2 in a row before close 5th of 6 last time; the switch to blinkers could eke out extra

runners.name: Ottoman
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent this season but caught wide when fifth at Chester last time and prior to that he was an easy winner over this C&D (good to firm); both wins have come at this venue and he's not ruled out.
runners.comment: Caught wide then fifth at Chester last time and easy winner over this C&D previously

runners.name: Mountbatten
runners.spotlight: Easily justified favouritism when upped in trip on his handicap and seasonal debut at Southwell (1m4f, AW) in June; last of four at Yarmouth (1m6f, good to firm) eight days later but remains very much of interest for a trainer who excels with this type of 3yo; wears first-time cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Easy win on handicap/seasonal debut; disappointing since but very much remains of interest

races.race_name: Dave Myers Memorial - I'm Having A Dave Day Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Cancelled
runners.spotlight: Promising fourth in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) at Beverley (8.4f, good to firm) last month and she showed a good attitude to beat Spiritoftheblues over this C&D (good to firm) 11 days ago; key player up 3lb.
runners.comment: Showed a good attitude to beat Spiritoftheblues over C&D 11 days ago; key player up 3lb

runners.name: Kaori
runners.spotlight: 1l third of six at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) in June on second handicap start and not beaten far in fifth at Lingfield (7f, good to firm) last time, when interference and possibly the drop back in trip were against her; wears first-time cheekpieces and could go well back up to 1m.
runners.comment: Close 3rd over 1m at Yarmouth in June & the drop back to 7f may not have been ideal since
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Venetian Sky
runners.spotlight: 0-5, all in novice races, but she kept on for fourth at Doncaster (7f, good) two starts ago and lost all chance when hampered at Chester (7f, good) last time; she's shaped as though the step back up to 1m could be a good move and she's firmly in calculations on handicap debut.
runners.comment: 0-5 but the step back up to 1m could be a good move on handicap debut

runners.name: Tamzan
runners.spotlight: Ran well in defeat in two handicaps in May (1m, good to firm/good) before winning a maiden at Beverley (8.4f, good) in June on her ninth start; went up the weights for that and she wasn't beaten by the trip when third of four back in a handicap at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm); improvement needed.
runners.comment: Won maiden at Beverley in June on ninth start; held in third of four in h'cap there since

runners.name: Spiritoftheblues
runners.spotlight: Won on debut at Ayr last August and runner-up in two of her three handicaps, finishing close up behind Cancelled over C&D (good to firm) 11 days ago having made the running; 3lb better off with the winner for just under 1l; trainer won this with a 3yo last year; in the mix.
runners.comment: Close second to Cancelled over C&D 11 days ago and she can be in the mix

races.race_name: ADS Handicap

runners.name: Art Lover
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in both nurseries but reappeared at Chester (6f, good) last month having been gelded and showed improved form in second of six, coming clear of the third; high on the list after that performance.
runners.comment: Runner-up on last month's reappearance at Chester and he's high on the list

runners.name: Percy's Star
runners.spotlight: Comfortably made all in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) on handicap debut here (5f, good) in June; however, only sixth of eight at Newmarket (5f, good to firm) since and has to leave that run well behind.
runners.comment: Won on handicap debut here in June but only sixth of eight at Newmarket since

runners.name: Sea Cookie
runners.spotlight: Won Newbury maiden (6f, good to firm) in June on third start and made it 2-2 for the year in handicap at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) later that month; down the field at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) since but it was a difficult race in which to make inroads from the rear; retains potential.
runners.comment: 2-2 for the year then down the field at Newmarket, but the race wasn't run to suit

runners.name: Evening Blues
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in a big field at York (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago and something to prove after that, but he was second of 14 over the same C&D (good) in June and is not written off.
runners.comment: Well beaten at York a fortnight ago but second over same C&D previously; not written off

runners.name: Ray Mon Dough
runners.spotlight: Impressive at Lingfield (6f, AW) last November on sole 2yo start and runner-up to very talented sprinter there (6f novice, good) in May; merely sixth on recent handicap debut at Chester (6f, good) but he's better than that and it will be no surprise if he's a force today; a tongue-tie goes on.
runners.comment: Merely sixth on recent handicap debut at Chester but he's better than that

runners.name: Nuevo Slovo
runners.spotlight: Won 2yo maiden at Ayr last April on second start but beaten a long way at big odds in handicaps on his two starts this year.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way at big odds in handicaps on his two starts this year

races.race_name: Leicestershire And Rutland Freemasons Charity LRFC Handicap

runners.name: Ricardo Phillips
runners.spotlight: Sole win (from 15 attempts) came here last July (1m4f, good); went very close behind Clipsham Noble over this C&D (good to firm) last month on his second start of the season; Leicester brings out the best in him and he has solid claims.
runners.comment: Sole win came here; went very close behind Clipsham Noble over C&D last time; solid claims

runners.name: Pisanello
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row at Redcar (1m1f/1m, good to firm) last month and completed hat-trick at Hamilton (1m1f, good) last Saturday; he's 6lb higher than last time and has never won over this far, but he's finished strongly for his recent wins and there's still plenty of mileage in his mark on old form.
runners.comment: Completed hat-trick last Saturday; still plenty of mileage in his mark on old form

runners.name: Clipsham Noble
runners.spotlight: Won here (1m4f, good to firm) in May and he returned to form with a win over this C&D (good to firm) last month, with three of these behind; he's just 2lb higher today and could play another leading role.
runners.comment: Two wins here this season, including last time; could play another leading role

runners.name: Kameel
runners.spotlight: Some good runs in defeat this year, including here; however, only fourth of six behind Clipsham Noble over C&D (good to firm) last time and he's 0-16 since winning his first two starts in winter 2024/25; first-time blinkers replace the visor.
runners.comment: Some good runs in defeat this year but below par over C&D latest and losing run continues

runners.name: Hachiman
runners.spotlight: Close third over C&D (good to firm) early last month and that performance puts him in the mix, but he's been inconsistent this year and was only fifth of six behind Clipsham Noble over C&D (good to firm) last time; the cheekpieces adopted on that latest start are left off.
runners.comment: Close third over C&D early last month but inconsistent and soundly beaten here last time
runners.owner: Paul K Spencer And Mrs R Carr

runners.name: Read All About It
runners.spotlight: Showed spark when third at 40-1 at Wolverhampton (9.4f, AW) in February for Tom Ward but well beaten in May on final two runs for that yard; a major turnaround is needed on stable debut (remains in same ownership).
runners.comment: Well beaten on last two starts and a major turnaround is needed on stable debut

races.race_name: Happy 100th Birthday Chepstow Racecourse "Training Series" Apprentice Handicap (RE Series)

runners.name: Sundiata Keita
runners.spotlight: 0-14 but has competitive form off higher marks and was runner-up over 5f here two weeks ago; won't be hindered by returning to 6f and blinkers might give him a lift.
runners.comment: Competitive form off higher marks and was runner-up over 5f here two weeks ago

runners.name: Some Nightmare
runners.spotlight: Be An Angel didn't get the best of runs when this gelding was hot on her heels here last month; found wanting in a classified race since then; looks vulnerable.
runners.comment: Be An Angel didn't get best of runs when this gelding was hot on her heels here last month
runners.owner: Mrs S M Maine & Roger Gould & Partner

runners.name: Be An Angel
runners.spotlight: Back in form, following her Salisbury win (6f, good to firm; first-time cheekpieces) with an unlucky second here and she wasn't beaten far despite finishing sixth last time; mark hasn't really gone anywhere so should be on the scene once more.
runners.comment: Continues to run well and her mark hasn't really gone anywhere; chance

runners.name: Outer Edge
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D two years ago but hasn't kicked on from an encouraging reappearance and looks vulnerable unless he can buck his ideas up.
runners.comment: C&D winner two years ago but hasn't kicked on from an encouraging reappearance
runners.owner: Int Plywood (lmporters) Ltd And C Mason

runners.name: Marisitta
runners.spotlight: Always prominent when belatedly off the mark over C&D in June and probably performed to a similar level when beaten 2l off this figure at Leicester; after steering clear of 6f for so much of her career, it's now looking a good fit.
runners.comment: After steering clear of 6f for so much of her career, it's now looking a good fit

runners.name: Macarone
runners.spotlight: Nutted on the line when backed at Ffos Las 12 days ago (6f, good) and gets in off the same mark, which is very favourable on peak form.
runners.comment: Nutted on the line when backed at Ffos Las 12 days ago; same mark here

runners.name: Macanudo
runners.spotlight: Has only won a Chelmsford 5f novice in 28 starts but well handicapped on best form and he was only 2l away over this trip at Nottingham a month ago (good to firm); has new handling this afternoon but should run well.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on best form and he was only 2l away over this trip at Nottingham
runners.owner: Giddy Up You Good Thing Racing Syndicate

runners.name: Arnaz
runners.spotlight: Has won only once, over 7f, during 25-race career; does have form at 6f but hasn't offered much in two runs after wind surgery.
runners.comment: Sole win at 7f; has form at 6f but not offered much in two runs after wind surgery

races.race_name: Coral Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Crystal Kraken
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who is moving gradually in the right direction; good second at Thirsk (6f, good to firm; nursery debut) most recently; possibilities provided she copes with the drop in distance.
runners.comment: Gradually moving in the right direction; good second at Thirsk last time; in the mix

runners.name: Dreamlover
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden who is proving rather a weak finisher; not disgraced in Lingfield nursery (dropped back to 5f) most recently but still needs to prove he can see things out to the line.
runners.comment: Proving a weak finisher; still needs to prove he can see things out to the line

runners.name: Dreams Galore
runners.spotlight: Held on narrowly, having dictated the pace, in similar event at Chepstow (6f, good to firm; nursery debut) last time; likely to be as effective back at 5f; open to further progress at this level; respected up just 2lb.
runners.comment: Bids for a Chepstow double; open to further progress at nursery level; respected

runners.name: Our Fella
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who came up short (finished last of three) in Class 4 event most recently; creditable second in Class 6 at Ffos Las (5f) the time before; the return to this grade looks a positive.
runners.comment: Creditable second in Class 6 on penultimate start; return to this grade looks a plus

runners.name: Defiant Dream
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who posted clear best effort, namely 50-1 second at Ffos Las, in sole attempt over 5f and only start in cheekpieces; could go well with those two factors back in play.
runners.comment: Posted clear best effort in sole attempt over 5f and only start in cheekpieces

runners.name: Devon Angel
runners.spotlight: Only one place behind Our Fella at Ffos Las (5f) last time, showing some improvement for the combination of first-time tongue-tie and switch to nursery level; may build on that effort.
runners.comment: Only once place behind Our Fella at Ffos Las last time, showing some improvement

runners.name: Chianti
runners.spotlight: Nursery debutant whose form figures of 543 reflect that he's steadily getting the hang of things; ran well over C&D (good to firm) most recently; interesting with another step forward plausible.
runners.comment: Steadily getting the hang of things; ran well over C&D most recently; interesting

runners.name: Cash Flow Boy
runners.spotlight: Has started at 28-1 in his novice races, best effort when fifth over C&D; ties in with Chianti on that form and goes handicapping with a more realistic chance than previously; one to bear in mind.
runners.comment: Goes handicapping with a more realistic chance than previously; one to consider

races.race_name: Wasdell Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations/ EBF Restricted Fillies' Maiden (GBB/IRE Inc')

runners.name: Global Success
runners.spotlight: Placed in two novice contests at Newbury and respectable fifth, belying her 50-1 odds, in competitive nursery at Glorious Goodwood since upped to 6f; leading form contender in an ordinary maiden.
runners.comment: Respectable fifth in competitive nursery at Glorious Goodwood last time; leading player

runners.name: Romidijo
runners.spotlight: Flashes her tail but has broadly consistent form; creditable second in nurseries at Chepstow (6f) and Lingfield (5f) on last two starts, doing well having started slowly latest; returns to this C&D with solid claims.
runners.comment: Flashes her tail but has broadly consistent form, including over C&D; solid claims

runners.name: Eastern Queen
runners.spotlight: Irish filly who showed ability with running-on fifth at Bellewstown, then understandably never figured when facing a much stiffer task in Listed grade at Naas; possibilities back down in class and upped to 6f.
runners.comment: Irish filly; faced stiff task in Listed grade last time; possibilities back down in class

runners.name: Bahia Bonita
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise with fourth of 11, just over 4l behind Global Success, in 6f event at Newbury; has frame possibilities as things stand and an even better chance if plausible improvement materialises.
runners.comment: Showed some promise with fourth of 11, behind Global Success, in 6f event at Newbury

runners.name: So Sexy Me
runners.spotlight: Sister to 6f AW winner Nursia (RPR 74), out of unraced sibling to UAE 1m4f Group 2 winner Bold Act and two 2yo scorers (6f/7f); sole newcomer in the field and starts off at an ordinary level; interesting.
runners.comment: Sister to a 6f winner and is related to two 2yo scorers; interesting debutante

runners.name: Golden Caturra
runners.spotlight: Ran according to market expectations (rank outsider of five) in 6f contest at Salisbury; drops to a slightly lower level but is perhaps one for handicaps later on.
runners.comment: Ran according to market expectations (outsider of five) in Salisbury contest

runners.name: Independent Roze
runners.spotlight: Last of five in both starts, achieving very little.
runners.comment: Last of five in both starts

runners.name: Voyage Of Survival
runners.spotlight: Folded tamely and well beaten in big-field maiden at Naas (6f) won by a Ballydoyle colt who followed up in the Richmond; may do better at this lesser level and is one of two Irish raiders who add interest.
runners.comment: Well beaten in big-field maiden at Naas but may do better at this lesser level

runners.name: Windmill
runners.spotlight: Ducked left at the start and always behind in 6f maiden at Newbury; may post a bigger effort at this easier-looking level with the experience under her belt; check the market signals for positive signs.
runners.comment: Always behind in Newbury maiden; may post a bigger effort in this field

races.race_name: Floyds Turfcar Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap

runners.name: My Mate Mackley
runners.spotlight: Campaigned over 5f since switched to handicaps, dead-heating at Chepstow the first attempt; most efforts since suggest this return to 6f is well worth exploring; major player.
runners.comment: Looks ready for another crack at 6f; returns to the scene of sole win (dead-heated)

runners.name: Ken Brulee
runners.spotlight: Holds a fighting chance on peak form, namely success off just 1lb lower in first-time cheekpieces at Lingfield (6f, good) in May; drops back in trip after attempting 7f last time.
runners.comment: Holds a fighting chance on peak form, namely Lingfield success off 1lb lower in May

runners.name: Go Victor
runners.spotlight: Proved markedly resurgent with 28-1 win at Pontefract (6f, good to firm) last time, ending a poor spell; still well treated on best 2yo figures; respected assuming he remains in form.
