runners.comment: Proved resurgent with Pontefract success last time; still well treated on best 2yo form

runners.name: Rogue Rebellion
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden on turf but is in a consistent vein of form, close fourth at Bath (5.7f) kept to classified level last time; gained his AW handicap success off current mark; solid chance.
runners.comment: In a consistent vein of form; gained his sole success (AW) off current mark; solid

runners.name: Geemann
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who has inconsistent form; posted one of his better efforts at Bath (5.7f) most recently but finished last of the five runners; not particularly solid.
runners.comment: Produced one of his better efforts last time but isn't a solid option

runners.name: Music And Song
runners.spotlight: Poor maiden over longer trips in Ireland for Tommy Dowling and well held at 100-1 in a 6f Lingfield AW classified on Saturday.
runners.comment: Poor maiden over longer trips in Ireland; well held in 6f AW classified on Saturday

runners.name: Cici's Secret
runners.spotlight: Eye-catcher on 2yo debut but has failed to build on that effort; trailed home last of ten, having pulled hard, at Salisbury (6f) on handicap/seasonal debut; something to prove.
runners.comment: Has failed to build on 2yo debut effort; finished last on reappearance

runners.name: Independent Angel
runners.spotlight: Far-from-solid maiden whose chance depends on whether she's capable of backing up latest effort, namely close fourth at Carlisle (6f, soft); has weak claims on previous form.
runners.comment: Chance depends on whether she's capable of backing up latest effort

races.race_name: DragonBet Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Devious Devan
runners.spotlight: Wolverhampton winner in May (8.6f); an eye-catching fifth at Kempton last month before another promising run from well off the pace at Windsor (1m, good to firm); could be interesting.
runners.comment: Has won only on the AW but quite an eye-ctaching run last time at Windsor

runners.name: Too Much Trevor
runners.spotlight: Only 2lb higher than when fending off Ajrad and Scarfo here last month (7f) but never threatened to follow up 16 days ago, again here; however, consistent in the main and couldn't rule out.
runners.comment: Only 2lb higher than when fending off Ajrad and Scarfo here last month (7f)

runners.name: Scarfo
runners.spotlight: C&D winner on soft ground in June and has continued to run well, last time back over 7f and just ahead of Ajrad; another solid candidate to consider.
runners.comment: C&D winner on soft ground in June and has continued to run well

runners.name: Desert Charm
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who so nearly brought up her hat-trick at Salisbury (1m, good to firm); has another 3lb to deal with but she's on the money right now.
runners.comment: Has another 3lb to deal with but she's on the money right now

runners.name: Ajrad
runners.spotlight: In a good run of form when winning this 12 months ago and returns after a close third here over 7f; nothing wrong with his mark.
runners.comment: Won this 12 months ago and returns after a close third here over 7f

runners.name: Galactic Glow
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner who has been in good form this season and found only one too good over C&D a month ago; could have done without the 2lb nudge but should be involved; has competitive form in the reapplied tongue-tie.
runners.comment: In good form this season and found only one too good over C&D a month ago

runners.name: A Rose Adaay
runners.spotlight: Has placed form but now 0-10 and had no excuses in a classified race last time.
runners.comment: Has placed form but now 0-10 and had no excuses in a classified race last time

runners.name: Redhot Whisper
runners.spotlight: Good 2yo form; remains a maiden after 20 starts but he's fallen a long way in the weights and, at odds of 4-1, was a clear second over C&D 55 days ago; considered.
runners.comment: At odds of 4-1, was a clear second over C&D 55 days ago; considered

runners.name: The Bureau Club
runners.spotlight: Hooded for all six races and now has a tongue-tie added; the drop back to 1m is slightly concerning when she finished well over 1m1f last time, but with a lightly raced profile and clearly in form, she's a likely contender.
runners.comment: With a lightly raced profile and clearly in form, he's a likely contender

runners.name: Weston Court
runners.spotlight: Closely matched with A Rose Adaay on their recent clash in a classified race; probably needs more back in a handicap and he's hard to win with (2-33).
runners.comment: Probably needs more back in a handicap and he's hard to win with (2-33)

runners.name: Fozzy Osbourne
runners.spotlight: Has raced five times, the standout effort when beaten a neck over C&D last month; latest defeat here was at 1m2f; each-way claims.
runners.comment: Beaten a neck over C&D last month and subsequent defeat was at 1m2f

runners.name: Beau Chevalier
runners.spotlight: A lightly raced 3yo but with no form claims, including two handicaps.
runners.comment: A lightly raced 3yo but with no form claims, including two handicaps

races.race_name: Capital Windscreens Supports Chepstow Centenary Celebrations Handicap

runners.name: Crimson Road
runners.spotlight: Prevailed by 1l in C&D contest (good to firm) last month on only his fourth start for current yard; back up only 3lb he remains attractively handicapped on 3yo form; respected.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D last month and remains attractively treated on 3yo form; respected

runners.name: Pride Of Nepal
runners.spotlight: Retains plenty of vitality aged eight but completed his May/June four-timer in Class 6 and was soundly beaten when back up in grade last time; current mark leaves him in a difficult spot.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten last time when bidding for five-timer and current mark is difficult

runners.name: Dancingondiamonds
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden whose form for current yard comprises two dismal efforts over hurdles and a modest third of four in 1m2f novice event at Doncaster; however, may improve now handicapping.
runners.comment: Modest third of four last time but may improve now handicapping
runners.owner: The Soldiers Of Fortune Iv & Partner

runners.name: Stipulation
runners.spotlight: Had a prolonged consistent spell until showing a dip in his form this spring/summer; well treated if getting back to his peak but others are preferred on recent evidence.
runners.comment: Had a prolonged consistent spell until showing a dip in his form this spring/summer

runners.name: Symphony's Song
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who has shown positive signs in her two handicap attempts, keeping-on third upped to 1m2f at Sandown (good to firm) latest; progress still looks possible; enters calculations.
runners.comment: Has shown positive signs in her two handicap attempts, third at Sandown latest

runners.name: Annexation
runners.spotlight: Veteran who completed a quickfire double last autumn but is 0-13 since and his second-place finish in June has not been backed up, kept to Brighton since; opposed.
runners.comment: Veteran whose second-place finish in June has not been backed up

races.race_name: Prix Daphnis - Jockey Club Argentino (Arg) (Group 3) (Turf)

runners.name: Distant Storm
runners.spotlight: Had plenty of smart performances as a juvenile, including a fine third placing in the Dewhurst, but wasn't at his best, for all that he was third, in the 2,000 Guineas on his return, albeit the first two continue to frank the form; did much better when cheekpieces went on for the Irish 2,000 under this rider, although Gstaad finished ahead of him again, and easy to like down in class.
runners.comment: Third in the 2,000 Guineas and then 2nd in the Irish version in cheekpieces; good claims

runners.name: Wild Desert
runners.spotlight: Posted some decent efforts as a 2yo and went close in a Woodbine Grade 1 (1m, firm) but not so good in 2026 and well beaten in a handicap last time; huge upturn in form required.
runners.comment: Grade 1 placed as a 2yo but beaten in a handicap last time; huge upturn in form needed

runners.name: Komorebi
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressing throughout his career, and won the Group 3 Prix de Fontainebleau at Longhchamp (1m, good) in April prior to claiming second in the Poule d'Essai Des Poulains (French 2,000 Guineas); not too far below that level when down the field in the Prix du Jockey Club when last seen, and drop in trip and grade should be a positive; Augustin Madamet rides him for the first time.
runners.comment: Mostly running well this year, the second in the Poule d'Essai Des Poulains a highlight

runners.name: Lord Clover
runners.spotlight: Made winning debut in February and quickly developed into a smart performer at around this trip; finished ahead of Campacite in the Group 3 Prix de Guiche in May (1m1f, good to soft) before not being beaten far in the German 2000 Guineas, a race the winner and second have boosted since; open to more improvement and one of the more interesting ones in the field.
runners.comment: Lightly raced and last piece of form is working out; interesting
runners.owner: Ballylinch Stud, Ecurie Euroling et al

runners.name: Saint Arnoult
runners.spotlight: Nicely bred son of Wootton Bassett, who comes into this off a pair of mile condition race wins (taking him to 3-4), most recently at La Teste De Buch on good ground; probably capable of further improvement and looks one to note in the betting under Christophe Soumillon for first time.
runners.comment: Won three of his four starts but this is a big step up in class; more needed
runners.owner: Jean-Claude Seroul, Gerard Augustin-Normand & Gerard Larrieu

runners.name: Campacite
runners.spotlight: Ran well in a couple of Group 1s as a 2yo, notably when second in the Criterium International (1m, very soft) in October, and run creditably this year without showing huge improvement; not beaten far as an outsider in the Prix du Jockey Club last time, which featured a few of these, and probably capable of better.
runners.comment: Ran well in a couple of Group 1s as a 2yo and probably still capable of better in 2026
runners.owner: Guy Pariente Holding, G Augustin-Normand & Ecurie Friedrider

runners.name: Lyneham
runners.spotlight: Won both starts as a 2yo over a mile on soft ground but was well behind Komorebi in the Group 3 Prix de Fontainebleau at Longchamp (1m, good) on his seasonal return and comes into this off a fourth at Newmarket in a mile Listed race; quite possible he wants much softer going ideally, so others are preferred.
runners.comment: Recorded best figure last time but was only fourth in Listed company; possibly wants soft

runners.name: Grand Son Of Dark
runners.spotlight: Won an Italian Group 3 over a mile in May, the Premio Parioli (Italian 2000 Guineas), and then went on to run to the same level  twice in a row when upped in distance, which included a neck second in the Derby Italiano (1m3f, heavy); coming back down in trip shouldn't be a worry and Maxime Guyon an interesting jockey booking.
runners.comment: Has been in good form in Italy and Maxime Guyon an interesting jockey booking

runners.name: Khovikhov
runners.spotlight: Posted a career best winning the 7f Group 3 Prix de la Porte Maillot on good ground (Alexis Pouchin rode for the first time) 52 days ago, with Synaran fourth, having been down the field in the Poule d'Essai Des Poulain prior to that; stepping back up to a mile holds no fears and already proven at the level, so holds place chances at least.
runners.comment: Posted a career best last time and won't mind going back over a mile

runners.name: Synaran
runners.spotlight: Useful as a 2yo but improved for a gelding operation during the winter, posting consistent figures and beating Kozlovskha in a Listed race at Longhamp in April when giving that colt weight; that rival gained his revenge in the Group 3 Prix de la Porte Maillot last time off levels, but the son of Mehmas didn't have a completely clear path; already won over a mile, so going back to that trip is fine, but still needs a bit more unless other underperform.
runners.comment: Solid type who should give his running, although needs extra on the figures

runners.name: Segall
runners.spotlight: Beat Synaran on his racecourse debut and won the Group 3 Prix la Force at Longchamp (1m1f, good to soft) in this year, but was then comfortably held in both the Poule d'Essai Des Poulains and Prix du Jockey Club; dropping in grade plus trip should help, and Pierre-Charles Boudot rides for first time.
runners.comment: Well held in Group 1s the last two times; drop in grade should help

runners.name: Wootton Centurion
runners.spotlight: Started career with a 6l win at Chantilly last September (1m, good), and then beat Lord Clover over the same C&D in April on soft; not seen since losing his unbeaten status in the Poule d'Essai Des Poulains from a wide draw in cheekpieces, where he didn't beat a rival, but three-month absence suggests something could have been amiss; gone well fresh in the past, so not easily dismissed.
runners.comment: Absent since down the field from wide draw in French 2000; has gone well fresh before

races.race_name: ARC Prix Maurice de Gheest - Fee - En Memoire de Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Turf)

runners.name: True Love
runners.spotlight: Matched Cheveley Park effort when winning this year's 1,000 Guineas and has run well in defeat all outings since, including in the Jean Prat over 7f here last time (in front of Samangan); slight drop in distance isn't a concern and she should run well.
runners.comment: 1,000 Guineas winner who has run well in defeat since; big chance down slightly in trip
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Division
runners.spotlight: Yet to win at three but has stepped up a fair way on his juvenile form, with his best effort to finish a close third in the Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot; bit below that level but still a respectable effort in the July Cup and he should appreciate this extra distance; player.
runners.comment: Yet to win at three but has run well in Group 1 races on his last two starts; player

runners.name: Rosy Affair
runners.spotlight: Consistent sort who turned in best effort when fourth to Mission Central in the King Charles III at Royal Ascot; below that at the Curragh last time and more a place prospect than a win-only one.
runners.comment: Below Royal Ascot form at the Curragh last time but has minor place claims

runners.name: Wise Approach
runners.spotlight: Turned in a clear pb when winning last year's Middle Park but long way below that level this season and ran as though something was amiss when tailed off in the Commonwealth Cup (trainer/vet couldn't shed any light on the run); reproduction of the Middle Park form gives him prospects but the percentage call is to oppose.
runners.comment: Middle Park winner last year but long way below that level all three starts this season

runners.name: Stolen Kiss
runners.spotlight: Improved performer with a decent strike-rate; won a conditions event at twice in Listed company before posting a career-best effort in the Queen Elizabeth II Jubilee Stakes at Royal Ascot; that form has been franked, he stays further than this trip and he's a player.
runners.comment: Career-best at Royal Ascot last time and no surprise to see him run well

runners.name: How Are You
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressive sort who turned in best effort to win Listed event over 6f at this venue last time; capable of better but big step forward needed if he's to win on first outing in Group company.
runners.comment: Steadily progressive sort who turned in best effort last time; more needed to win this

runners.name: Take Charge Star
runners.spotlight: Has improved with every run and turned in his best effort when second to subsequent Group 1 Jean Prat winner Thesecretadversary in the Jersey at Royal Ascot; cheekpieces fitted for this slight drop in trip and may be capable of better; interesting.
runners.comment: Turned in best effort when second in the Jersey at Royal Ascot; may be capable of better

runners.name: Samangan
runners.spotlight: Group 2/3 winner at Chantilly last autumn and has posted respectable efforts in the Group 1 Commonwealth Cup/Jean Prat on last two starts; cheekpieces fitted last time are on again and he's another with place claims.
runners.comment: Group 2/3 winner last autumn and respectable efforts in Group 1 company of late; claims

runners.name: Mise En Boite
runners.spotlight: Given weight and a beating by Stolen Kiss at Chantilly in May but turned in his best effort when winning Group 3 event over 6f at this course last time; this demands a big step forward.
runners.comment: Best effort to win a Group event here last time; this demands a big step forward

runners.name: Summer Sail
runners.spotlight: Very useful sort who won conditions event on heavy at Chantilly in May; well beaten behind Mise En Boite on first run in Group company last time; makes no appeal.
runners.comment: Very useful sort but well beaten in first Group race last time; tough task

runners.name: Afandy
runners.spotlight: Has won three of his five starts, the pick being when beating Samangan in the Group 3 Djebel in April; failed to match that in a steadily run Group 2 last time but should get a better gallop to aim at and he has each-way prospects.
runners.comment: Best effort to win the Djebel but lack of pace found him out last time; each-way claims
